name: Arlberg-Panoramacamping
beschreibung: The **Arlberg-Panoramacamping** campsite is located in the municipality of **Pettneu am Arlberg** in the Austrian state of **Tyrol**. Situated elevated in the valley, it offers a **panoramic view** of the surrounding mountains of the **Arlberg** region. The site is peaceful and nestled in nature. The area is characterized by marked **hiking trails** in summer and a network of **cross-country ski tracks** in winter. The location is close to the valley stations of the **Ski Arlberg** ski lifts, accessible via a **ski bus**. The facilities include sanitary buildings and pitches with **electricity**
